mods.name: Create: Pocket Sized
mods.description:
Experimental alpha: back up worlds before testing.
Create-flavoured spatial compression and contraption logistics for Sable sublevels, built on Pym.
Shrink and enlarge vehicles and structures, pocket the miniature directly,
recover wrecks, weld crafts of different sizes together with the Hot Glue Gun, and fire unprotected
pocketed contraptions with Create machinery.

releases.notes: ### Foreword **Dear reader,** I am very excited to share the last major "pillar" feature I intend for Pocket Sized v1.0, wearable hats! I've spent weeks testing and improving their stability, and I'm finally confident enough to share them with everyone. That said, Hats work very differently from Pocket Sized's existing scaling systems, so please be aware that incompatibilities with other mods are still possible. If ever your Hat or Pocket Case goes missing, I've added a new _Lost & Found_ menu, accessible with command ./pocket recover, to help keep your art safe. I'm also working on Ponders and better in-game documentation for Pocket Sized's mechanics. There's a lot to explain, and I know the current documentation isn't where it needs to be yet, so feel free to ask any questions in the meantime. Thank you for all your support so far. It genuinely means the world to me, and I can't wait to see what you make with Pocket :) _-MisterBluSky_ ## REQUIREMENTS - Pehkui 3.8.3 or newer is required. - Pym 0.7.1 is my scaling library currently bundled inside the Pocket jar. No separate download needed. - Client and server must both be on Pocket 0.32.0. # Pocket Sized v0.32.0 ## Hats!™ - To make a Hat!™, use any head-wearable item on the Hat Stand, then build directly on the Dummy's head. - To pick up and wear your creation, Shift + Right-click either the bare Dummy head or the base of the stand if the head is obscured by your hat blocks. You can edit your hat at any time by placing it back on the stand. - Added the Hat Stand, Tall Hat Stand and Skull Cap, with crafting recipes for both stands. Craft a stand alone to reset it. - A craftable Dummy Head skull makes for a cheaper Hat Stand recipe, and crafting a Hat Stand using a named player skull transfers its name to the stand. - Hold down R-Click with a Wrench to turn the stand's head. - 2 toggles on the Hat Stand, left is 1st-person mode (default OFF) and right is display helmet model (default ON). - Hats can be sealed using Hot Glue or Honey Glue on the stand's base, this works just like Pocket Cases already do. - Hats can have moving parts! Sublevels attached to a hat keep simulating while it's worn, their physics bodies are under bedrock. - Place Pocketed Sublevels on Hats!™, R-Click a Hat Stand with a filled Pocket Case to use native Create's schematic tools to place its contents. Create schematics can be deployed directly onto hats using the same logic. - Hats and Pocket Cases are protected from fire damage as items or entities, like Netherite gear, and the Physics Staff can't grab hats. - Skull Cap has no armor value nor durability, and its hat blocks are exactly 1/16x scale (for pixel perfect builds) - Cardboard Helmet Hats (and Skull Cap Hats) will make your player appear as the hat instead of a package when sneaking in a full suit of Cardboard Armor. This is for Prop Hunt purposes, clearly. - Hat Stands can be renamed via a nametag, and some names have apply ~ magical™ ~ effects to the hats that use them! - Some easy ones are: "jeb_" - Wool blocks become rainbow "Dinnerbone" or "Grumm" - Hat and player head are rendered upside down "KEYGEN" - Custom Rainbow Enchantment glint is applied to the hat, made in GIMP using the original glint as a base "melons" - All blocks on the hat will act as if they were a Copycat Facade block, rendering their 1x texture "Herobrine" and many more you will have to discover on your own... ### Pocket Cases & Schematics - Pocket Cases can now capture entire Hot Glued groups of sublevels, including sublevels at different scales, and redeploy them together. ...

releases.notes:
# Hats!™ Pre-release 3 w/ Pym v0.7.0

This is an experimental build for testing.

**Highly experimental, seriously... back up your worlds before trying it.**

That is usually said out of an abundance of caution but this time I mean it. -blu

## Hat Stand™ & Mechanics
- To make a Hat!™, use any head-wearable item on the Hat Stand, then build directly on the Dummy's head.
- To pick up and wear your creation, Shift + Right-click either the bare Dummy head or the base of the stand if the head is obscured by your hat blocks.
- You can edit your hat at any time by placing it back on the stand.

### NEW
## Better Hats!™
- Added new toggle for displaying the Hats!™ in 1st person & displaying the hat model at all.
- You can now place Pocketed Sublevels on Hats!™, R-Click a Hat Stand with a filled Pocket Case to use native Create's schematic tools to place its contents.
- Create schematics can also be deployed directly onto existing hats using the same logic
- Hats can now be sealed using Hot Glue or Honey Glue on the stand's base, this works just like Pocket Cases already do
- Added a craftable Dummy Head skull for a cheaper Hat Stand recipe.
- Crafting a Hat Stand using a named player skull now transfers its name to the stand.
- Added several new Hats!™ related advancements.
- Hats and their moving parts have improved positioning &rendering.
- Hats and Pocket Cases are now protected from fire damage as items or entities, like Netherite gear.

## Pocket Cases & Schematics
- Pocket Cases can now capture entire Hot Glued groups of sublevels, including sublevels at different scales, and redeploy them together.
- Create schematics ALSO now preserve individual sublevel scales and Hot Glue weld connections.
- You can now clone independent copies of Pocket Cases and Hats in Creative only by middle-clicking them (Pick Block Keybind)
- Scaled Schematics now store their scale and it can be seen in the tooltip.
- Schematic & Quill will auto-select all welded sublevels if you shift-rclick onto one of them.

## Lost & Found
- Added new Lost & Found menu for recovering lost Hat and Pocket Case items. To access it, you must have op and use the cmd /pocket recover
- The Lost & Found menu supports searching, the items will show last seen date/time for moderation.

## Compatibility & Rendering
- Conveyor belts now work on scaled vehicles! So does TNT impact and brittle blocks breaking at high impacts.
- Added Vista TV compat, View Finders and televisions can now work with Hats!™, including hat mounted cameras or TVs.
- Vista cameras don't render the Hat's model or the player's head if it'd block its view.
- Accessories compatibility alongside Curios.
- Fixed Copycat Facade rendering bug that could be seen when placed on leaves or grass blocks.

## Misc
- Added /pocket usecustomsprite to toggle a hat's custom item sprite, this can be used to hide that a Hat is custom and not a normal helmet...
- Improved creative inventory actions.
- New Epoch system for pocketed sublevels to prevent unwanted duplication and lost tickets.
- Much more I forget rn.

## Pym v0.7.0

### Scaled Schematics
- Create schematics can now save and restore scaled sublevels while retaining their original sizes.
- Schematic previews, transformations, and placement now account for sublevel scaling.
- Added support for fractional schematic positioning on smaller grids.
- Added new schematic APIs for other mods to preserve additional sublevel information.

### Mod Compatibility
- Added experimental Create: Submarine scaling compatibility, including buoyancy, waterlines, flooding, and implosion calculations.
- Added experimental Electroenergetics compatibility, including wire visuals and connections when sublevels resize.

### Physics & Entities
- Improved collision callbacks for scaled sublevels, so collision-triggered block behavior can use the correct original block positions.
- Fixed additional issues with forces and collision interactions across different scales.

# Hats!™ Pre-release 2 w/  Pym v0.6.5
This is an experimental build for testing.
****Highly** experimental, seriously... back up your worlds before trying it.**
That is usually said out of an abundance of caution but this time I mean it. -blu

## Hat Stand™ & Mechanics
- To make a Hat!™, use any head-wearable item on the Hat Stand, then build directly on the Dummy's head.
- To pick up and wear your creation, Shift + Right-click either the bare Dummy head or the base of the stand if the head is obscured by your hat blocks.

### NEW
- Added the Tall Hat Stand™.
- Added crafting recipes for both stands. Craft alone to reset it,
- Added a Skull Cap™ and head turning on the stands when you hold down R-Click with a Wrench.
- Hats can now have moving parts! Sublevels attached to a hat keep simulating while it's worn, their physics bodies are under bedrock somewhere far away.
- 2 new toggles for the Hat Stand™, left is 1st-person mode (default OFF) and right is display helmet model (default ON)
- Create Connected's wildcard links work on hats.
- The Physics Staff can no longer grab hats.
- Added many Easter Egg names for the Hat Stand™s that apply ~ *magical™* ~  effects to the hats that use them.

## Misc
- More previously hardcoded strings are now in lang files.

## Pym v0.6.5
- Added a new 'Hosted' sublevel lifecycle, which lets worn builds keep running real physics. Hosted builds on the 'Detached' idea from v0.6.
- Pym is bundled inside Pocket, so both client and server need pocket-0.30.0-beta.2.jar if using on a server.

Please report bugs and compatibility issues with logs for debugging. Enjoy!

# Hats!™ Pre-release 1 w/  Pym v0.6
This is an experimental build for testing.
****Highly** experimental, seriously... back up your worlds before trying it.**
That is usually said out of an abundance of caution but this time I mean it. -blu

## New Hat Stand & Mechanics
- To make a Hat!™, use any head-wearable item on the Hat Stand, then build directly on the Dummy's head.
- To pick up and wear your creation, Shift + Right-click either the bare Dummy head or the base of the stand if the head is obscured by your hat blocks.
- You can edit your hat any time by placing it back on the stand.

- Sublevels stored in Pocket Cases now render using the same Detached Pym pipeline that I created for Hats!™ and tick/update when held, worn, or placed on a depot.

## Pocket Knife Sublevel Slicing & Assembly
- R-Click with the Pocket Knife to select a region of the world, on a sublevel or the world grid.
- This will slice the sublevel into segments according to your selection, or will assemble the blocks as if you used a Physics Assembler if world grid.

## Pym v0.6

- Adds a new 'Detached' sublevel lifecycle with rendering APIs and interaction rules. This is used by Pocket for all live sublevel rendering.
- Pym is bundled inside Pocket, so both client and server need pocket-0.25.0-beta.1.jar if using on a server.

Please report bugs and compatibility issues with logs for debugging. Enjoy!

releases.notes: ## REQUIREMENTS - Pehkui 3.8.3 or newer is required. - Pym 0.5.0 is my scaling library currently bundled inside the Pocket jar. No separate download needed. - Client and server must both be on 0.24.0. ## Pym v0.5 ### Collision & LOD Optimizations - All entities now use LOD colliders for sublevels (based on relative scale) to prevent lag. - Very large or complex scaled colliders fall back safely instead of failing to build. - Large entities use a faster water check. - Scaled sublevels skip water checks in chunks with no water. - Simulated Coaster optimizations for tiny rollercoasters. - Pym's scaling no longer affects 1x sublevels & players. ### Physics - Split sublevels inherit their original scale, and both halves continue resizing if split during a resize. - Splitting a sublevel while it's resizing no longer freezes the 2 halves. - Breaking blocks too quickly no longer causes scaled sublevels to suddenly pop back to 1x. - Disassembling scaled crafts grows them back to 1x, so they shouldn't clip into the world anymore. - Disassembly uses the same clipping-protection ground clearance as normal growing. - Mass is re-synced during resizing, so firing planes out of the Potato Cannon should no longer make them explode. - Sublevels fired out of the Potato Cannon should be much more stable. - Tiny crafts have a much lower minimum weight. - Scaled sublevels now have proper ice physics, stickyness, bouncyness, and similar block properties. Conveyor belts don't work yet. - Water physics and buoyancy should be much more accurate and stable. - Propellers keep their full thrust according to scale. - Magnets and docking connectors are scale-aware. - Springs can now connect sublevels of different sizes too. - The contraption diagram now works on scaled crafts. ### Players & Entities - Shrinking while standing near the edge of a sublevel tries to keep you on by pushing the player a bit. - Giant players can lift more with handles, while tiny players lift less. - Player handle offsets now scale properly with player size. - Punch forces now scale with player size. - Arrows now push crafts according to their size. - Create's Schematic tools reach and draw at your scale. ### Mod Compatibility - Transmission & Linkage universal joints and hydraulics now use scaled lengths, and render at the smaller scale of the 2 connected crafts. - Transmission & Linkage rod lengths, rendering, and collision are adjusted for the scales of both connected sublevels. - Wheel suspension now works properly on cars over 2x scale. Before, the suspension couldn't detect extend far enough. Suspension on slopes is improved. - Wheel suspension extension now scales properly on enlarged crafts. - Aeroworks gyroscopes no longer break upon relogging, but might be underpowered on smaller sublevels. - Experimental Trackwork and Tracks support. ## Pocket Sized v0.24 ### Scaling Tools - Compression guns now use Alt to toggle grow/shrink instead of Shift + Scroll. They only use durability when out of Levitite Blend, and now have 60 durability. - Personal Subspace Compressor no longer has durability, so it can be refueled when empty instead of breaking. - PSC has a new keybind (unbound by default) that works from your hotbar or belt slot. Hold Shift with it for the scale menu. - Compression guns/PSC can now use the Capacity enchantment. Each lvl of Capacity adds 1/3rd more Levitite Blend storage to the tank (can change in configs). - Sitting in a tiny seat now sets your PSC's target scale to that seat for convenience. - The Portable Subspace Compressor now resizes everything joined to its craft along with it. ### Pocket Knife Polish ...

Everyone standing on it rides along unless they have PVP Scaling protection on. - Players sitting in seats always resize with their craft. - Giant players can lift more with handles, while tiny players lift less. - Punch forces now scale with player size. ## PHYSICS & LINKS - Flexible Shafts have no physics impulses or springyness, so they can connect crafts of different scales. - Flexible Shafts and Couplings are weightless, and snap when stretched past 1.5x their length. - Springs can now connect sublevels of different sizes too. - Scaled sublevels now have proper ice physics, stickyness, bouncyness, and similar block properties. - Water physics and buoyancy should be much more accurate and stable. - Propellers now keep their full thrust according to scale. - Magnets and docking connectors are scale-aware. - The contraption diagram now works on scaled crafts. - Blueprint Casing is less sticky (was 4, now 1.65, same as soul sand), and its encased variants keep that stickyness. ## COMPATIBILITY - Transmission & Linkage universal joints and hydraulics now use scaled lengths, and render at the smaller scale of the 2 connected crafts. Rod hitboxes scale properly too. - Optional Curios support for the Personal Subspace Compressor's belt slot. - Wheel suspension now works properly on cars over 2x scale. Previously the suspension couldn't detect extend far enough. ## POLISH & MISC - The Create: Pocket Sized creative tab has a new hand-crafted animated banner! - Levitite Blend buckets are now in the Pocket creative tab. - Hot Glue has its own whitish grey slime textures and particles. - Empty Boxes now stack to 16. - Display Bottles, Display Cases, and Display Plates no longer stack. - Scale menu preview has dirt under the grass now. - New config option to let creative players pocket sublevels of any size. ## FIXES - Copycat Façade renamed to Copycat Facade, without the diacritic. - Creative Worldshaper no longer drops the block used on a Copycat Facade. - Fixed a texture seam on the Pocket Knife. I still plan to overhaul its model. - Sublevels fired out of the Potato Cannon should be much more stable. - Disassembling scaled crafts grows them back to 1x, so they shouldn't clip into the world anymore. - Breaking blocks too quickly no longer causes scaled sublevels to suddenly pop back to 1x. - Splitting a sublevel while it's resizing no longer freezes the two halves. ## PYM & PHYSICS - Scaled sublevel hitboxes now match exactly what Sable builds at 1x. - Split sublevels inherit their original scale, and both halves continue resizing if split during a resize. - Mass is re-synced during resizing, so firing planes out of the Potato Cannon should no longer make them explode. - Tiny crafts have a much lower minimum mass instead of being forced to weigh at least 0.25kg. - Player handle offsets now scale properly with player size. ...

releases.notes:
Create: Pocket Sized Alpha v0.22.0 w/ Pym 0.4.1

REQUIREMENTS
- Pehkui 3.8.3 or newer is required.
- Pym 0.4.1 is bundled inside the Pocket jar. No separate download needed.
- Client and server must both be on 0.22.0.

COMMANDS
- /pocket sethandscale <scale> sets the held Creative Shrinkray or Personal Subspace Compressor scale, takes 0.0625 or 1/16

FLEXIBLE SHAFT
- It just carries shaft rpm, no physics impulses/springyness
- Snaps if stretched too far like a spring though
- Can connect sublevels of different sizes, visual tapers between them which is subject to change but looks fine for alpha purposes
- Flexible Coupling is now 'weightless' with Aeronautics tagging

PYM
- Physics Assembler grows small crafts back to 1x with the same clipping-protection ground clearance as normal growing, so they don't clip into the ground when disassembling
- Step-up finally follows the sublevel's block size
- All scales of players stand up and change pose properly under low ceilings on scaled sublevels
- Fixed near-plane clipping getting doubly scaled with Pehkui
- Physics Staff hold distance follows the larger scale between player &sublevel
- Block breaking particles on scaled crafts reworked, more to come on this.
- Fixed a crash caused by loading a scaled craft with no mass

MISC
- Blueprint Casing has more friction
- Brass Display Plate is now visible via the creative tab
- Compression Cannon & Personal Subspace Compressor use up their levitite blend internally first, and only then try to use durability
- Punchy compat
- a few more tiny fixes.

SAVE GAMES
- Back up your world before updating please.
- Resized sublevels keep their scale when you update.

KNOWN ISSUES
- Collision can still lag when a large entity stands on a much smaller sublevel
- Pressure plates and similar blocks on 1/32 crafts don't react to 1x players. This is as an attempt to fix the lag mentioned previously...
- Scaled Contraptions (native Create ones, like the Mechanical Bearing) have no collision.

releases.notes:
Create: Pocket Sized Alpha v0.21.0 w/ Pym 0.4.0

NEW REQUIREMENTS
- Pehkui 3.8.3 or newer is required.
- Pym 0.4.0 is bundled inside the Pocket jar. No separate download needed.
- Client and server must both be on 0.21.0.

LICENSE
- Pocket & Pym code is now under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0. Assets stay All Rights Reserved. See LICENSE.md

NEW
- Blueprint Casing (replaces Blueprint Tile). New Omni texture, encased shafts, cogwheels, and large cogwheels with it.
- Flexible Shaft and Flexible Coupling (WIP)
- Magnifying Glass (WIP)

PYM
- Springs can't connect blocks of different sizes because rn they explode often
- Transmission & Linkage hydraulics and universal joints now scale and taper between different sized crafts
- Faster entity lookups around scaled sublevels
- Experimental Simurail support, off by default
- New links API so other mods can make connected sublevels scale together

PONDERS
- Highly experimental new ponder ability to scale a sublevel inside a ponder
- For now, just a basic test on the Creative Shrinkray, please report any issues with viewing this before I proceed with making more comprehensive in-game docs using Ponders.

SCALING TOOLS
- Hold Ctrl while firing the Compression Cannon or Creative Shrinkray to rescale only the target, not its neighbours
- L-Click a target with the Personal Subspace Compressor or Creative Shrinkray to pick its scale
- Portable Subspace Compressor now has a Resize Protection lock
- Creative Shrinkray entity targeting fix which was causing crashes with absurdly small sublevels nearby

HOT GLUE
- Aim at a block's far edge to help glue faces hard to pick otherwise
- Welded crafts now scale around the weld pivot

MISC
- Pocketed case tooltips now show size at scale and entity count
- Schematic and Quill works on sublevels
- Punchy compat
- Fixed weld lines getting thick when zoomed in
- a bunch more tiny fixes.

CONFIGS
- resizeEntitiesOnCrafts moved to Pym as resizeEntitiesWithSublevels (default true).
- New Pym option: experimental.simurailSupport (default false).

SAVE GAMES
- Back up your world before updating please.
- Resized sublevels keep their scale when you update.
- Blueprint Tiles become Blueprint Casings when you update.

KNOWN ISSUES
- Collision can still lag when a large entity stands on a much smaller sublevel
- Pressure plates and similar blocks on 1/32 crafts don't react to 1x players. This is as an attempt to fix the lag mentioned previously...
- Scaled Contraptions (native Create ones, like the Mechanical Bearing) have no collision.
